advance.q: How far in advance can I book a ride?
advance.a: You can book months ahead or as little as 60 minutes before pickup. We recommend booking with lead time when possible. Free cancellation up to 1 hour before pickup; changes are available until 60 minutes before.

vehicles.q: What vehicles does AL MAJD use?
vehicles.a: We offer Business Class, First Class, and Business Van/SUV options. Vehicle availability varies by city. Browse illustrative options in our Help Center.

languages.q: Which languages do the chauffeurs speak?
languages.a: Our chauffeurs speak English as well as the local language.

payment.a: We accept Visa, Maestro, Mastercard, and American Express. Cash is not accepted. PayPal and Apple Pay are available in our apps. Corporate clients can also arrange monthly invoicing.

sustain.q: How does AL MAJD contribute to sustainable travel options?
sustain.a: Electric vehicles are incorporated into Business Class and First Class in many cities, and we automatically offset emissions with our carbon offset program — whichever vehicle class you choose.

faqs.imageAlt: Chauffeur loads luggage into the back of an AL MAJD limousine.

commission.q: Can travel agencies earn commission through AL MAJD?
commission.a: Yes. Our partnership model lets agencies earn commission without managing end-to-end operations. Speak to our team via the <contact>contact form</contact>.

clientInfo.q: What information does my client receive?
clientInfo.a: Booking confirmations go to the booker only and never include price for the passenger. Passengers are contacted only when the chauffeur is on the way, has arrived, or to clarify the pickup location.

vehicles.q: What vehicles does AL MAJD use?
vehicles.a: We offer Business Class, Business Van/SUV, First Class, electric options, and Sprinter vehicles depending on city availability.

advance.q: How far in advance can I book a ride?
advance.a: Months ahead or as little as 60 minutes before pickup. Free cancellation up to 1 hour before; changes until 60 minutes before.

sustain.q: How does AL MAJD contribute to sustainable travel options?
sustain.a: Electric vehicles are available in select cities, with ongoing expansion in Business Class, plus automatic carbon offset on every ride.

pricing.q: How does AL MAJD's pricing fare against traditional providers?
pricing.a: Transparent, competitive, distance-based pricing without compromising quality — built for agency partners and their clients.

partner.q: Can anyone become an AL MAJD partner?
partner.p1: We only partner with insured, pre-existing chauffeur companies.
partner.i2: Submit documentation for your business, one vehicle, and either yourself or one of your company's chauffeurs
partner.p3Before: Once your account is active, begin your partner application

rides.q: How many rides can I do with AL MAJD per month?
rides.a: The amount of rides you perform is entirely up to you. The volume of rides available is dependent on regional and seasonal demand.

paid.a: You receive a monthly invoice for the previous month, including extras such as wait time or route changes. Payments are made via wire/bank transfer and usually visible in your account by the 17th of the month.

vehicles.q: Which vehicles can I use to work with AL MAJD?

apply.q: How do I apply to partner with AL MAJD?
